description: Send Feedback: a small dialog (560 px wide, title "Feedback") for writing a note, an issue or a suggestion, optionally with screen captures of the app window; with the Capture bar at the bottom of the window while a capture is pending, and the Mark regions dialog over a capture. Baude's and Record's. Saved notes are listed in Ongoing Feedback and, when GitHub is signed in, filed as an issue.
opens: key Cmd+. (macOS) / Ctrl+. (elsewhere), over whatever is open
the + button in Ongoing Feedback's list header

parts.name: Header bar
parts.shows: Title "Feedback". Cancel at the left, Save (the suggested, accent-coloured button) at the right; no window close buttons.

actions.does: throws the draft away (note and captures) and closes
saves, as Save, when Save is enabled; does not insert a new line

parts.name: Capture strip
parts.shows: Above the note, only when there are captures: a horizontally scrolling row of thumbnails, each 160 px on its longer side, the marked regions outlined over it in the accent colour. Each thumbnail has a tag at its bottom left ("click to mark regions" when none, else "1 region" / "N regions") and a round close button at its top right.

actions.by: click a thumbnail (tooltip "Mark regions on this capture", magnifier pointer)
actions.does: opens the Mark regions dialog over it; when that closes the note has the focus again
drops that capture; focus back to the note

parts.name: Note box
parts.shows: A rounded card like the chat's composer, a multi-line text box, 140 px tall growing to 280 then scrolling, words wrapping, text kept clear of the + at its bottom right corner. Has the focus when the dialog opens, cursor after any text already written. Text selection is not drag-dropped away.

parts.name: + button (add capture)
parts.shows: A flat + button at the box's bottom right. Tooltip "Add a screen capture: go to it, then press Capture"; when something sits over the window (a dialog, the large image viewer, Kubernetes or Database Schemas), "Capture what's open now".

actions.does: puts the dialog away and shows the Capture bar; or, with something over the window, closes the dialog and captures that at once (a double click is ignored)

parts.name: Capture bar
parts.shows: While a capture is pending, a bar slides up at the bottom of the window (the dialog is gone, so you can go to what you want to show): a camera icon, the line "Feedback: go to what you want to show, then capture it" (ellipsized), then Cancel and Capture (suggested style) at the right. Always a capture of the window itself: its picture and the text on screen, each line with where it was and which part (sidebar, chat, side panel, input box, status bar, header, banner, Kubernetes, databases, image).

actions.does: hides the bar at once (it is not part of the picture), waits 120 ms, captures the window, then opens Mark regions over the capture
hides the bar and reopens the Feedback dialog with the draft
with the bar showing, same as Capture

parts.name: Mark regions dialog
parts.shows: A large dialog (1100 x 760) titled "Mark regions": Clear at the left of its header, Done (suggested) at the right; under the header a dimmed centred hint that depends on where the note will go: "Drag over what you mean · those words go in the note's GitHub issue on <repo> · right-click a region to remove it" (repo known), "... go in the note's GitHub issue · ..." (repository known but not signed in), or "... those words stay with the note · ..." (nowhere to file). Below, the capture fitted whole (not cropped) and centred, crosshair pointer; each marked region is outlined in the accent colour (rounded, 2 px) with its number in a small accent-coloured tab on its top-right corner, just above it (inside only at the very top of the image).

actions.does: outlines a region live; on release it is added (ignored if 4 px or less in either direction); the text on screen inside the region is what goes in the note and the issue
closes; when it was a fresh capture, the Feedback dialog reopens with it added

states.name: empty
states.shows: Save disabled until there is text or at least one capture

states.name: draft kept
states.shows: The text and captures stay in the window's draft while the dialog is closed for a capture, and across a Baude restart; Cancel clears it

states.name: Saving
states.shows: Save writes feedback/<time>/ under the app's data folder (feedback.md with the note, where it came from, and the text in each marked region quoted; capture-N.png, capture-N-marked.png, capture-N.txt, captures.json); the dialog closes; a toast "Feedback saved" ("Feedback saved, filing it…" when GitHub filing is available) with an Open folder button, 6 seconds

states.name: filing result
states.shows: A while after, another toast: "Filed as an issue on <repo>" with an Open issue button (8 s); or "Saved, and it'll be filed on <repo> when it can be" (with ": <first line of why>" up to 100 characters) for 10 s. Filing is retried every minute for unfiled notes, by either app; "Another window is filing this" if two race.

states.name: context in the note
states.shows: The note carries, under Context: the session id and title, the folder, the app's path, and, when Attach open chat transcripts is checked, the open chat's and Meta's transcripts in code fences (as Copy Transcript copies them, shared out of a budget so the issue body stays under GitHub's limit)

states.name: over a dialog or full view
states.shows: With something over the window, + captures it straight away without showing the bar (the bar couldn't be pressed). Opening the dialog from the menu with a capture pending hides the bar. The key does nothing while Feedback or Mark regions is open.
